resources.string: Repeats marker taps and performs taught taps, swipes, and Back actions. Automation processes screen images and target app names on this device. On-device connection uses ADB on this device. Stop automation from the control panel.

2. Choose target apps

Use learning or a recording for actions without a built-in preset. Check the status on unfamiliar screens.

No PC or Shizuku is required. Wi-Fi is needed to start the worker. The worker then disconnects from ADB. Operation after Wi-Fi is turned off still needs device testing. Keep USB debugging enabled; no cable is required. Start again after a restart or force stop.

Enable Wireless debugging and open Pair device with pairing code. Accessibility reads the code and device details to pair, connect, and start the worker.

A saved key can connect without pairing again. If reading fails, use Enter connection details. Stop all also cancels connection setup.

Use independent screen anchors to recover the current state. On unregistered screens, use readable controls in the target app and check the result. Outcomes and timing may be reused across games, while screens and coordinates are verified in the target. A step is reused only after at least two successes and a success rate of 66% or higher.

If controls or results cannot be read, demonstrate the action or create it from a recording. Unreviewed recording actions and daily completion are not assumed.

After saving, tap Start to resume.
Without a relative position, the center of the condition region is normally used. Some built-in actions use a dedicated position. Edit a setting learned in the target window to use a relative tap.

Have you reviewed transitions without actions and edited the required taps or swipes? A transition without an action only waits for the next screen. Configuration checks do not prove success in the app. Start automation manually after review.
Replace this app\'s states, transitions, and regions with the defaults. Current settings will be backed up.
Delete all transitions for this app. States and regions remain. Use Undo in the easy editor to reverse this change.

No video upload is required. After starting learning, use the target normally and tap Finish and create after one cycle. Taps, paths, and marker demonstrations are recorded.\nIdentical screens become the same state. Conflicting actions on the same screen are held until their conditions can be distinguished.

Display the screen showing all daily missions complete and rewards collected.
1. Mark the completion text or icon.
2. Mark the mission-screen heading.
The next app starts only when both match. Do not use a blank area or a Play button alone as completion evidence. For Usapo, include the game name or game-specific mission criteria in the second region. Normal and virtual display rules are saved separately.

Keep existing states and branches while adding or repairing the parts confirmed in the recording. Current settings will be backed up.\nAfter saving, recheck the same recording or continue with another one. Saving does not start input.
Demonstrate one tap or swipe.\nCancel from the learning controls.

Legacy text commands use the Japanese command grammar. Prefer Choose action or the graph editor for localized controls.\n\nStored commands, captured screen text, and user-defined names are kept in their original language. Unsupported command text is not executed.
